data.exact_reserve_text: The underwriting profit of GBP 12.0m in 2014 (2013, loss of GBP 27.4m) includes a release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6m (2013, GBP 4.4m deterioration).

prior_year_events.impact_description: A distribution of GBP 4.7m to members has been proposed in relation to the 2012 year of account, indicating a net profit/release on closure.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1400 reported a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 10.6 million in 2014, which contributed to an underwriting profit. This release represents approximately 3.04% of the opening gross claims outstanding. Additionally, the 2012 year of account closed with a proposed distribution of GBP 4.7 million to members, indicating a net profit for that year of account.
